name: alevel-physics-animations
description: Classroom-ready A-Level Physics (CIE 9702) animations: physics-red-line Manim videos, native-animation PowerPoint decks, and a persistent teacher memory with privacy filters. Native WorkBuddy plugin, no external frameworks.

interface.shortDescription: CIE 9702 physics animations: correct-by-construction Manim videos and native-animation PowerPoint decks.
interface.longDescription: Classroom-ready A-Level Physics (CIE 9702) plugin for teachers. Two pipelines: continuous motion renders as Manim videos with explicit physics red lines (equal-time spacing, F=ma, energy conservation, centripetal direction, exponential decay, and more), while sequential text reveals become PowerPoint decks with native entrance animations. A persistent local memory records every teacher-requested modification automatically (repeats count up instead of duplicating), fixed mistakes automatically, and habits on request, with forget-with-trace. New conversations load the memory first and apply it. Built-in privacy filters keep credentials, student data, intranet addresses, and absolute paths out of memory and courseware. Pure skills + scripts: no MCP servers or extra frameworks.
defaultPrompt: Render a projectile-motion video that shows the 1:3:5 vertical spacing red line.
Build a PowerPoint deck for capacitors where each step appears on click.
Show my remembered habits and the top recurring physics mistakes.
